dataset.name: CAMELSH: A Large-Sample Hourly Hydrometeorological Dataset and Attributes at Watershed-Scale for CONUS
dataset.citation: Tran et al., Scientific Data (2025), doi:10.1038/s41597-025-05612-6
dataset.streamflow_units: m3 s-1 (converted from USGS cfs with the 0.0283168 constant in datatransform.m)
dataset.streamflow_statistic: hourly mean of USGS Instantaneous Values Service readings (parameter 00060, typically 15 to 60 minute cadence), labelled by hour start
dataset.missing_values: IEEE NaN, no interpolation; all USGS flag classes are retained
dataset.basin_polygons: Provided as CAMELSH_shapefile.shp (GAGES-II derived) and CAMELSH_shapefile_hydroATLAS.shp, field GAGE_ID, in shapefiles.7z
dataset.archive_format: Hourly2.zip: one deflate-compressed NetCDF4/HDF5 file per gauge, named <STAID>_hourly.nc with variables time, streamflow, water_level

acquired.member_manifest: selection.json plus fetch-log.jsonl (per-station csize, usize, crc32, sha256, request bytes)

summary.note: valid hours are hours with a non-NaN streamflow value; NaN hours are missing observations, not gaps that were filled.

not_acquired.reason: Original-release NLDAS-2 forcing plus streamflow bundle; superseded for streamflow by Hourly2.zip and not needed for onset compatibility.
Gauges without observed streamflow; outside the training population.
Catchment polygons for all 9,008 basins, including the reserved cohort; deferred until a candidate cohort is chosen.
5,188-gauge streamflow and water level archive; record is access restricted and was superseded by the open Hourly2.zip.
Hourly ERA5-Land forcing for 9,008 basins, about 2.4 GB per year; this task needs streamflow semantics, and the project already provides its own weather pipeline.
Benchmark simulations, actual-forecast archives and stream temperature; not streamflow observations.
